phases.objective: Make Repository Inventory regeneration a bounded recipe of the existing governed generated-artifact writer while keeping pull-request verification read-only and automatic dispatch fail-closed around exact-head, trust, determinism, and write-set checks.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository inventory verifier, trusted dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request on a governed work branch fails Repository Inventory because only the canonical inventory outputs are stale, or a trusted operator explicitly invokes the dispatcher with the exact current PR identity.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The read-only verifier and dispatcher prove exact identity, zero-behind freshness, trusted control surfaces, deterministic inventory generation, and an exact three-file dirty set before delegating repository_inventory_refresh to the existing writer; the writer applies only the registered outputs with exact-head CAS, non-force push, post-push readback, and exact-head read-only verification.
steps: Run Repository Inventory on the exact pull-request head without repository write permission or persisted checkout credentials.
Require an open same-repository pull request targeting main and a governed non-protected work branch.
Require the source failure or manual request to bind the current exact head SHA and require behind_by to equal zero.
Refuse automatic repair when the writer, verifier, dispatcher, governance registry, package contract, or Inventory generator differs from trusted main.
Generate the three Repository Inventory outputs twice and compare SHA-256 identities to prove deterministic bytes.
Run the Repository Inventory currentness and contract regressions and reject any dirty path outside the exact three-output allowlist.
Delegate repository_inventory_refresh to Governed Generated Artifact Refresh without granting the dispatcher contents write permission.
Revalidate expected_head_sha after generation and immediately before mutation, reject main and Production, create a bounded commit only when outputs changed, and push without force.
Read the remote branch after push and require it to equal the generated commit SHA.
Dispatch Repository Inventory as the exact-head read-only verifier on the resulting SHA.
assertions: Repository Inventory pull-request verification has contents: read only and performs no git push.
Repository Inventory regeneration writes exactly docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, and docs/repository-inventory.md.
Two generation passes produce identical SHA-256 hashes before repository mutation is considered.
inventory currentness and inventory contract tests pass before a generated commit is created.
The dispatcher rejects fork pull requests, non-main bases, stale source heads, protected targets, and branches that are behind main.
The automatic dispatcher refuses to execute candidate-modified mutation authority and requires the trusted control surface to match main.
The dispatcher has actions write only in the delegation job and never receives contents write permission.
The governed writer requires an exact expected_head_sha and typed confirmation, rejects main and Production, and never force-pushes.
The writer supports a no-op outcome when Repository Inventory is already current.
The remote branch readback after a generated commit must equal the resulting commit SHA.
Generated-artifact verification routes repository_inventory_refresh to Repository Inventory rather than a generic verifier.
Force push, protected-branch mutation, Production deployment, database mutation, and secret publication are outside this feature.

phases.objective: Observe a trusted post-merge stale-only Inventory repair on a non-protected work branch and retain canonical exact-head verification evidence.
Exercise stale SHA, branch drift, changed authority surface, nondeterministic generation, dirty-set escape, no-op, dispatch failure, and post-push readback mismatch paths.
Use the first eligible non-production Inventory drift as a bounded canary for automated stale-only repair.
Keep main and Production outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets while allowing the merged verifier and dispatcher contracts to govern ordinary work branches.
